date component.
Baseline was the last non-missing assessment prior or on the first dose date.

R = repeat/unscheduled assessments. CS = Clinically Significant; NCS = Not Clinically Significant; ND = Not Done.
Laboratory ranges are based on NCI-CTCAE version 4.03.
